description: A function called inside a 'use cache' scope to associate one or more string tags with the cached entry for targeted on-demand invalidation.
The two-argument invalidation API that marks tagged cache entries as stale according to a cacheLife profile (such as 'max'), serving stale data while refreshing in the background.
A Server Action-only invalidation API that immediately expires tagged cache entries so the next read waits for fresh data, guaranteeing read-your-own-writes consistency.
The guarantee that after a user performs a mutation in a Server Action, the immediately rendered UI reflects their newly written state rather than a stale cached snapshot.
